task_definition.task_name: Seismic Data Spectrogram Computation and Plotting

task_description.overview: Generate a time-frequency representation (spectrogram) of a seismic waveform stream using ObsPy.
steps: Load the seismic data into an ObsPy Stream object from the provided file path or URL.
Call the Stream.spectrogram() method to compute and plot the spectrogram.
Customize plot parameters such as logarithmic scaling, colormap, and title as needed.
Display or save the spectrogram figure for analysis.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the seismic waveform stream from {seismic_stream_source} into an ObsPy Stream object. Compute and plot its spectrogram with logarithmic scaling enabled. Output the spectrogram figure, applying an appropriate colormap. 
 Note: 1) Save the spectrogram plot to {result_plot}.
